title: git_commit accepts broad pathspecs and commits unrelated staged files
wanted_capability: A commit tool whose explicit paths restrict both staging and committed content, rejecting broad pathspecs and validating every expanded file for sensitivity.
missing_primitive: Validated exact path selection and index isolation
fallback_used: Inspected the implementation and reproduced only in an isolated temporary repository.
notes: Synthetic isolate probe with peer.txt already staged and paths=[mine.txt] committed both files. A second call with paths=[.] also succeeded. No real repository was committed by these probes. See design/bro-harness/model-facing-tools-audit.md.
resolution_note: Addressed on fix/harness-tool-contracts: literal-file preflight refuses directories/globs/magic/symlinks/sensitive paths and foreign staged work; selected-path commit excludes late peer staging and handles deletions. Five isolated Git behavioral tests pass; full workspace nextest passes.
